messages.subject: delays in 2.0.1
parts:
We ran into back-end problems with some underlying functions
that are going to need to be fixed and then filtered through
our testing process. So it'll be a few days before we can
release a stable 2.0.1 version.

The good news is that we've tracked down all the issues.

- Bob
